Overview

Kohima is a city in Nagaland with a population of 120,000. The capital of Nagaland, a hill station known for its WWII battlefield, Naga tribal culture, and the annual Hornbill Festival. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
